name: Checkpoint 性能诊断
description: Checkpoint 是 PostgreSQL 将共享缓冲区中的脏页刷入磁盘的过程，确保崩溃恢复时只需重放 checkpoint 之后的 WAL。正常情况下 checkpoint 由 checkpoint_timeout（默认 5 分钟）或 WAL 量达到 max_wal_size 触发。当 checkpoint 过于频繁（requested checkpoints 多）、完成时间过长（write_time 高）、或后端进程被迫自己刷脏页（buffers_backend > 0）时，I/O 性能受影响，查询延迟出现毛刺。

signals.desc: pg_stat_bgwriter.checkpoints_req 持续增长（WAL 触发的 checkpoint 多于 timed checkpoint）
pg_stat_bgwriter.buffers_backend > 0（后端进程自己刷脏页，说明 bgwriter/checkpoint 跟不上）
日志出现 LOG: checkpoints are occurring too frequently

conditions.desc: 请求型 checkpoint 占比超过 50%（应主要由 timed 触发）
buffers_backend 每分钟超过 100（后端进程在刷脏页）
日志中出现 checkpoint 过频繁警告

skip_when.desc: checkpoints_req = 0 且 buffers_backend = 0，checkpoint 完全由定时触发
低写入负载（WAL 产生量 < 100MB/分钟），checkpoint 压力不大

root_causes.name: checkpoint_completion_target 过低
root_causes.desc: checkpoint_completion_target 控制 checkpoint 写入操作应在多长时间内完成（占两次 checkpoint 间隔的比例）。默认 0.9（PG14+），旧版默认 0.5。如果设得太低（如 0.5），checkpoint 试图在一半时间内完成所有脏页写入，I/O 突发集中导致延迟毛刺。

root_causes.name: max_wal_size 过小导致频繁 checkpoint
root_causes.desc: max_wal_size（默认 1GB）控制两次 checkpoint 之间允许产生的 WAL 量。高写入负载下 WAL 快速增长超过阈值触发 requested checkpoint。频繁 checkpoint 的问题：每次 checkpoint 后的第一次页面修改需要写入 full page image（FPI），增加 WAL 量形成恶性循环。

root_causes.name: shared_buffers 过大导致脏页过多
root_causes.desc: shared_buffers 设得太大（如 16GB+），checkpoint 需要刷写大量脏页。如果存储写入带宽有限，checkpoint 无法在 completion_target 时间内完成，大量脏页堆积。后端进程找不到干净缓冲区时被迫自己刷脏页（buffers_backend）。

root_causes.name: 存储写入延迟高
root_causes.desc: 存储设备的写入延迟高（HDD、网络存储、云磁盘 IOPS 限制），checkpoint 和 bgwriter 的刷盘速度跟不上脏页产生速度。表现为 checkpoint_write_time 和 checkpoint_sync_time 过长。

root_causes.name: bgwriter 配置不足
root_causes.desc: bgwriter 负责在 checkpoint 之间预先刷写脏页，减轻 checkpoint 压力。如果 bgwriter_lru_maxpages（默认 100）或 bgwriter_lru_multiplier（默认 2.0）过低，bgwriter 每轮刷的页面太少，脏页积压到 checkpoint 时集中刷写。

step1_checkpoint_stats.desc: 查看 checkpoint 和 bgwriter 统计信息
step1_checkpoint_stats.sql: SELECT checkpoints_timed, checkpoints_req, ROUND(checkpoints_req::numeric / GREATEST(checkpoints_timed + checkpoints_req, 1) * 100, 1) AS req_pct, ROUND(checkpoint_write_time / 1000.0, 1) AS write_time_sec, ROUND(checkpoint_sync_time / 1000.0, 1) AS sync_time_sec, buffers_checkpoint, buffers_clean, buffers_backend, buffers_backend_fsync, buffers_alloc, maxwritten_clean, stats_reset FROM pg_stat_bgwriter

step2_checkpoint_frequency.sql: SELECT checkpoints_timed + checkpoints_req AS total_checkpoints, ROUND((checkpoints_timed + checkpoints_req)::numeric / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - stats_reset) / 3600, 1), 2) AS checkpoints_per_hour, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - stats_reset) / GREATEST(checkpoints_timed + checkpoints_req, 1) / 60, 1) AS avg_minutes_between FROM pg_stat_bgwriter

step3_checkpoint_settings.desc: 查看 checkpoint 相关参数
step3_checkpoint_settings.sql: SELECT name, setting, unit, short_desc FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('checkpoint_timeout', 'checkpoint_completion_target', 'checkpoint_flush_after', 'checkpoint_warning', 'max_wal_size', 'min_wal_size', 'shared_buffers', 'bgwriter_delay', 'bgwriter_lru_maxpages', 'bgwriter_lru_multiplier', 'bgwriter_flush_after', 'full_page_writes', 'wal_compression') ORDER BY name

step4_buffers_ratio.desc: 分析缓冲区刷写来源比例（checkpoint vs bgwriter vs backend）
step4_buffers_ratio.sql: SELECT ROUND(buffers_checkpoint::numeric / GREATEST(buffers_checkpoint + buffers_clean + buffers_backend, 1) * 100, 1) AS checkpoint_pct, ROUND(buffers_clean::numeric / GREATEST(buffers_checkpoint + buffers_clean + buffers_backend, 1) * 100, 1) AS bgwriter_pct, ROUND(buffers_backend::numeric / GREATEST(buffers_checkpoint + buffers_clean + buffers_backend, 1) * 100, 1) AS backend_pct, maxwritten_clean AS bgwriter_maxed_out FROM pg_stat_bgwriter

step5_io_stats.sql: SELECT backend_type, object, context, reads, read_time, writes, write_time, writebacks, writeback_time, fsyncs, fsync_time FROM pg_stat_io WHERE writes > 0 ORDER BY writes DESC
step5_io_stats.note: PG12-15 无此视图，需依赖 OS 级工具（iostat、iotop）

step6_dirty_buffers.desc: 估算当前共享缓冲区中的脏页比例
step6_dirty_buffers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_buffers, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE isdirty) AS dirty_buffers, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE isdirty)::numeric / GREATEST(COUNT(*), 1) * 100, 1) AS dirty_pct FROM pg_buffercache
step6_dirty_buffers.note: 需要安装 pg_buffercache 扩展: CREATE EXTENSION pg_buffercache;

step7_wal_between_checkpoints.desc: 估算两次 checkpoint 之间的 WAL 生成量
step7_wal_between_checkpoints.sql: SELECT pg_size_pretty(current_setting('max_wal_size')::bigint * 1024 * 1024) AS max_wal_size, pg_size_pretty(current_setting('min_wal_size')::bigint * 1024 * 1024) AS min_wal_size, current_setting('checkpoint_timeout') AS checkpoint_timeout

step8_checkpoint_log.desc: 检查日志中的 checkpoint 相关记录
step8_checkpoint_log.note: 搜索 'checkpoint starting' 和 'checkpoint complete' 记录。建议设置 log_checkpoints = on

decision_tree.step: Step 1: 检查 checkpoint 统计 — requested vs timed 比例

branches.label: requested checkpoint 占比高 — WAL 量超过 max_wal_size 触发
branches.confidence: 置信度 85%: requested checkpoint 占比 > 30% 说明 max_wal_size 偏小
findings: checkpoint_completion_target 过低: requested checkpoint 比例过高，WAL 生成速度超过 checkpoint_timeout 内的 max_wal_size

actions.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET max_wal_size = '4GB'; SELECT pg_reload_conf();
actions.rollback: ALTER SYSTEM SET max_wal_size = '1GB'; SELECT pg_reload_conf();

branches.label: checkpoint 以 timed 为主 — 频率正常
findings: checkpoint 触发模式正常，以定时触发为主

decision_tree.step: Step 2: 检查 checkpoint 频率

branches.label: 每小时 checkpoint 次数过多
branches.confidence: 置信度 80%: checkpoint 过于频繁
findings: max_wal_size 过小导致频繁 checkpoint: 每小时超过 6 次 checkpoint，I/O 压力大

actions.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET checkpoint_timeout = '15min'; ALTER SYSTEM SET max_wal_size = '4GB'; SELECT pg_reload_conf();

decision_tree.step: Step 3: 检查 backend 直写比例

branches.label: backend 直写占比过高 — bgwriter 清理不及时
branches.confidence: 置信度 80%: backend 直写 > 20% 说明脏页清理速度不足
findings: shared_buffers 过大导致脏页过多: 后端进程被迫自己写脏页到磁盘，影响查询延迟

actions.desc: 调整 bgwriter 参数加速清理
actions.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET bgwriter_lru_maxpages = 400; ALTER SYSTEM SET bgwriter_lru_multiplier = 4.0; SELECT pg_reload_conf();

branches.label: bgwriter maxed out — 清理量达上限
findings: bgwriter 达到 maxwritten_clean 上限次数过多

branches.label: 脏页比例过高
branches.confidence: 置信度 75%: 脏页占 buffer cache 超过 30%
findings: 存储写入延迟高: 脏页积累过多，checkpoint 写入压力大

actions.desc: 增大 shared_buffers 或调整 checkpoint_completion_target
actions.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET checkpoint_completion_target = 0.9; SELECT pg_reload_conf();

decision_tree.step: Step 5: 检查 checkpoint 参数配置

branches.label: 参数已获取 — 评估合理性
findings: 检查 checkpoint_timeout、max_wal_size、checkpoint_completion_target 等参数是否合理

decision_tree.step: Step 6: 检查 sync 时间 — 存储 I/O 性能

branches.label: sync 时间过长 — 存储 I/O 瓶颈
branches.confidence: 置信度 80%: checkpoint sync 耗时 > 10 秒说明存储延迟高
findings: bgwriter 配置不足: checkpoint sync 耗时异常，底层存储可能是瓶颈

actions.desc: 检查存储子系统性能，考虑使用 SSD 或调整 I/O scheduler

caused_by.name: WAL 写入
caused_by.relationship: 大量 WAL 产生触发频繁 checkpoint

caused_by.name: 表膨胀
caused_by.relationship: 膨胀的表增加共享缓冲区中的脏页数量

causes_of.name: WAL 写入
causes_of.relationship: 频繁 checkpoint 导致大量 full page writes 增加 WAL 量

causes_of.name: 查询计划退化
causes_of.relationship: checkpoint I/O 突发导致查询延迟毛刺，表现类似计划退化

related.name: VACUUM/Autovacuum
related.relationship: VACUUM 产生的脏页增加 checkpoint 负担

emergency_playbook.scenario: checkpoint 导致严重 I/O 风暴，查询全面变慢

steps.action: 确认当前 checkpoint 状况
steps.sql: SELECT checkpoints_timed, checkpoints_req, buffers_checkpoint, buffers_backend, ROUND(checkpoint_write_time / 1000.0) AS write_sec, ROUND(checkpoint_sync_time / 1000.0) AS sync_sec FROM pg_stat_bgwriter

steps.action: 查看是否有正在执行的 checkpoint
steps.sql: SELECT pid, query, wait_event, state FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'checkpointer'
steps.note: PG14+ 显示 checkpointer 进程状态

steps.action: 增大 max_wal_size 减少 checkpoint 频率
steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET max_wal_size = '8GB'; ALTER SYSTEM SET checkpoint_timeout = '30min'; SELECT pg_reload_conf();
steps.rollback: ALTER SYSTEM RESET max_wal_size; ALTER SYSTEM RESET checkpoint_timeout; SELECT pg_reload_conf();

steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET checkpoint_completion_target = 0.9; SELECT pg_reload_conf();

steps.action: 增强 bgwriter 减少后端刷脏页
steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET bgwriter_lru_maxpages = 400; ALTER SYSTEM SET bgwriter_lru_multiplier = 4.0; ALTER SYSTEM SET bgwriter_delay = '100ms'; SELECT pg_reload_conf();
steps.rollback: ALTER SYSTEM RESET bgwriter_lru_maxpages; ALTER SYSTEM RESET bgwriter_lru_multiplier; ALTER SYSTEM RESET bgwriter_delay; SELECT pg_reload_conf();

version_specific_notes.12: checkpoint_completion_target 默认 0.5。bgwriter 默认参数可能偏保守。无 pg_stat_io 视图
version_specific_notes.13: WAL 统计改进。pg_stat_bgwriter 统计更精确。recovery_target_action 用于备库恢复后行为
version_specific_notes.14: checkpoint_completion_target 默认改为 0.9（重要改进）。新增 pg_stat_wal 视图。compute_query_id 默认开启
version_specific_notes.15: VACUUM 新增 BUFFER_USAGE_LIMIT 减少对共享缓冲区的影响。shared_buffers 使用改进
version_specific_notes.16: 新增 pg_stat_io 视图提供详细 I/O 统计（reads、writes、fsyncs、时间）。checkpoint 日志改进。vacuum_buffer_usage_limit 全局参数
version_specific_notes.17: checkpoint 写入性能改进。pg_stat_io 增强。改进的 checkpointer 进程调度。更好的脏页追踪机制

real_world_examples.scenario: 每 30 秒一次 checkpoint 导致数据库性能周期性下降
real_world_examples.symptoms: 每 30 秒查询延迟出现 2-3 秒的毛刺，pg_stat_bgwriter 显示 checkpoints_req 以每分钟 2 次的速度增长
real_world_examples.root_cause: max_wal_size=256MB（从旧版升级时未调整），高写入负载下 30 秒就产生 256MB WAL 触发 checkpoint。checkpoint_completion_target=0.5 导致 I/O 集中在 15 秒内完成
real_world_examples.resolution: max_wal_size 从 256MB 增到 4GB，checkpoint_completion_target 从 0.5 改为 0.9，checkpoint_timeout 从 5min 改为 15min
real_world_examples.result: checkpoint 间隔增到 12-15 分钟，I/O 均匀分散，延迟毛刺消失

real_world_examples.scenario: buffers_backend 占比 30% 导致查询性能不稳定
real_world_examples.symptoms: 相同查询有时 5ms 有时 500ms，pg_stat_bgwriter 显示 buffers_backend 占总刷写的 30%
real_world_examples.root_cause: shared_buffers=16GB 但使用 HDD 存储，bgwriter 默认配置（delay=200ms, maxpages=100）清理速度远跟不上。后端进程获取干净缓冲区时经常被迫自己 evict 并刷脏页
real_world_examples.resolution: bgwriter_lru_maxpages 增到 400，bgwriter_delay 降到 100ms，bgwriter_lru_multiplier 增到 4.0。同时评估是否需要减小 shared_buffers 或升级 SSD
real_world_examples.result: buffers_backend 占比从 30% 降至 < 1%，查询延迟变得稳定
